summary: Ownership and server-controlled roles protect privileged data in the tested scenarios. No role-escalation or cross-customer access bypass was reproduced. The score reflects broken feature/rule compatibility and incomplete data validation, rather than a demonstrated external compromise.

findings.issue: Profile notification settings write notificationsEnabled, which the user schema and update allowlist reject. The control shows a changed local state despite a failed backend write.
findings.recommendation: Define the supported notification schema, validate the preference boolean on create/update, await writes, and implement token/permission/delivery handling before advertising push updates.

findings.check: Type Safety and Business Logic vs. Rules
findings.issue: Bouquet recipe validation accepts a bounded map without validating entries, referenced flowers or checkout stem limits. A florist can publish a 101-stem recipe which the order backend rejects. This was reproduced in the emulator.
findings.recommendation: Validate published recipes through a trusted product-management path and share the supported recipe limits with the florist form and checkout backend.

findings.issue: Saved addresses valid under the rules can have null coordinates. The order handler accepts these and deducts stock, while the dispatch feed and rider acceptance exclude them. A hidden ready order was reproduced.
findings.recommendation: Require a confirmed delivery pin at checkout or define a recoverable review state and location-repair workflow before stock-consuming dispatch confirmation.

auditStage: Initial audit before remediation; see postRepair for current status.
correction: The original favourite-field allowlist finding was incorrect: keys().hasOnly was already present. It has been removed.
